material.acceptance_criteria: After a hero dies, its expanded team-strip row reads state dead with a zero or blank hp, not the pre-death value, on the next refresh.
material.description: Symptom: an expanded team-strip row for a dead hero shows the last hp read while alive, under state dead. Cause: scenarios/moba/panels.lua:194 stores hp only in the alive branch; the dead branch (panels.lua:196) sets state without clearing hp. game.units() lists living units only (rust/crates/mod-host/src/piccolo_host.rs:2215), so the dead branch always runs. Shown at panels.lua:318. Contract broken: HEROES[p].hp must hold the hero's current hp. Working-tree line numbers at trav-hud-lua-L2 walk; panels.lua grew 14 lines below line 505 during the walk.

notes.note: Duplicate of ILLEGAL-trav-hud-lua-L1-3 (same dead-hero hp defect at panels.lua:194-196 and 318). Merge into ILLEGAL-trav-hud-lua-L1-3 by the owner.

material.subject: Dead hero row in team strip shows the hp it had while alive
material.witness: Duplicate of ILLEGAL-trav-hud-lua-L1-3, closed on its own witness (one output closes one row). Premise absent on the working tree (codesearch dispatch 1792862297344-5413-35e143b3b0877b62): the strip has no hero rows. HEROES is written at panels.lua:182-195 and read by no render (its only other use is the reset at 633). No team-strip row shows hp, so no dead row can show a stale hp.
material.witness_plan: Live match: expand the team strip, let a hero with hp above zero die, read that row's hp at the next refresh and compare with the value before death.
